versions.changelog:
Initial release of English Listening Coach: an interactive, structured tool for practicing English listening, dictation, and vocabulary with authentic materials.

- Runs full guided sessions using real passages from top ESL sites: listenaminute.com, breakingnewsenglish.com, dailydictation.com, and englishclub.com.
- Adapts every activity to the learner's level and topic preference, scaling dictation/gap-fill difficulty.
- Provides step-by-step practice: warm-up, dictation, answer checking, detailed feedback, vocabulary practice, comprehension questions, pronunciation focus, and extension activity.
- Gives encouraging, actionable feedback for every error; tracks session progress and suggests next steps.
- Includes a daily listening drill feature with higher-level, natural-speed content (TED, BBC, VOA, podcasts) and structured comprehension questions.
